title: Four Ways to Feel Morocco
subtitle: From sand seas to snow-capped peaks, pick the landscape that speaks to you and we'll help you plan around it.

desert.title: Sahara Desert Camps
desert.desc: Camel trekking, starlit bivouacs, and sunrise over the dunes of Merzouga and Zagora.

medina.title: Timeless Medinas
medina.desc: Lose yourself in the souks, riads, and artisan workshops of Fes and Marrakech.

coast.title: Atlantic Coastline
coast.desc: Surf, fresh seafood, and sea breezes along Essaouira and Agadir's shores.

mountains.title: Atlas Mountain Villages
mountains.desc: Hike Berber trails, visit kasbahs, and stay in mountain guesthouses near Ifrane.
